phase_0.boundary_condition: The consistency assumption of the formal system

VINIT.justification: Pre-encoding state where syntax and arithmetic are undifferentiated; the uninitialized formal system before Gödel numbering begins.

TANCH.justification: The closed logical limit that contains the system; once consistency is assumed, the system cannot prove its own completeness.

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism mapping syntactic symbols and formulas to unique natural numbers, enabling arithmetic representation of logic.

AREV.justification: Contravariant mapping from arithmetic back to syntactic meaning, allowing the system to 'read' its own encoded statements.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of encoding and substitution, composing the numbering function with the diagonalization operator to produce self-reference.

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-reference where the constructed formula G asserts its own unprovability; the element recognizes itself within the arithmetic domain.

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication branching the formal system's completeness ideal into two distinct paths: syntactic derivability and semantic truth.

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication reconstituting the original formal system by fusing the diverged branches, recovering the system's true state as incomplete.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch evaluating G as true in the standard model of arithmetic, outside the system's proof limits.

EVALF.justification: Negative branch evaluating G as unprovable within the system, demonstrating the failure of internal derivation.

ENGAGR.justification: Both truth and unprovability held simultaneously; the statement exists in a paraconsistent state where neither branch resolves the other.

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation permanently recording the incompleteness result; the meta-mathematical fact becomes an append-only truth.

phase_3.void_description: Unencoded axiomatic void; syntax and arithmetic are fused, no self-reference exists yet.
phase_3.true_description: Semantic truth established in the meta-model; G is recognized as true beyond the system's proof capacity.
phase_3.false_description: Syntactic unprovability within the formal system; G cannot be derived from axioms via inference rules.
phase_3.both_description: The paradice of G; simultaneously true and unprovable, held in meta-theory without internal resolution.
